Marquee

Marquee, an artificial intelligence-powered insights platform for soccer data, has raised a $4M seed round led by AnD Ventures and with participation from Axel Springer SE, Welltech Ventures, Apex Capital, 97212 Ventures and JCP. The round follows a $2.5M pre-seed raised earlier this year (also led by AnD) and brings the startup’s total funding to $6.5M.The new capital will be used for research and development; to hire talent across AI, engineering and data science; and to set up offices in the U.S. and the U.K.

Launched earlier this year and based in Tel Aviv, Marquee bills itself as an “intelligence layer” for scouting, recruitment and analytics. Its platform combines nine custom-built AI models, which sit atop clubs’ existing competition data and can be queried for text-based insights. Marquee claims more than 20 professional soccer teams and federations as clients -- including teams from MLS, the Premier League and Serie A -- and has data integration partnerships with SkillCorner and Gradient Sports. The company is also currently developing a basketball platform.
